name: get_structural_context
description: Return the physical neighborhood of a residue in its AlphaFold-predicted 3D fold, to reason about whether the residue is structural (buried, tightly packed — holding the fold together) or functional (surface-exposed — doing a job). Given a UniProt accession and a 1-based residue position, returns relative solvent accessibility (rsa, 0=buried..1=exposed), secondary structure (H/E/C), packing (contact_count and nearest_contacts), and an AlphaFold per-residue confidence (plddt, 0-100). Use it to tell buried structural residues apart from functional surface residues; pair it with conservation, which the structural signal does not replace (buried active-site residues look structural on geometry alone).

position.description: 1-based residue position in the canonical UniProt sequence.

include_embedding.description: Include the raw per-residue PLM embedding vector (large; default false — it is for downstream ML, not agent reasoning).

embedding.description: Per-residue PLM vector; null unless include_embedding=true.
